preview.reason: Two fully rendered shader-baking exports exceeded the ten-minute GPU-turn budget. Preview uses normal runtime compilation; game/HUD materials, geometry, lighting and quality settings are unchanged.

hudEquivalence.note: Only upstream KDE Help Center/Gwenview/search UI changes since this export. The complete R5-authored runtime/assets set is byte-identical. Exported build source remains explicitly labelled.

method: Finite one-shot Playtest review dispatches ordinary console and runtime input/pause handlers in the exported binary. Game capture --os-window reads the verified rendered client without OS focus; window-input is used ONLY for focus-free sizing. No inspection bridge, listener, HUD-value injection or repainting.
setup: Invincible live player with actual equipped inventory; spawn 20 real riflemen, normal input targets a head and fires. Server resolves ammunition, raycasts, kills, score and the real care-package offer. Whole stream overlay is debug-masked for pure HUD views.
